description: Parkings véligos à Grand Paris Sud is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant les parkings vélos Île-de-France Mobilités (anciennement dénommés "stations Véligo"). Définition Les parkings vélos Île-de-France Mobilités sont un service de stationnement de vélos offrant des abris en libre-service et des consignes collectives sécurisées. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Vélo, Stationnement, Gare, veligo. The portal shows 48 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-01-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
